evidence.excerpt: To address this, we introduce SatNav, a scalable, long-horizon UAV VLN benchmark built from high-resolution satellite imagery.

evidence.excerpt: To stress-test long-horizon memory and geospatial reasoning, SatNav defines three task families: Boundary, Landmark, and Route, targeting loop progress tracking, landmark-based spatial grounding, and route following with counting cues.
